answer: Make identity cost a copper token staked against a harvest: each agent earns the right to speak only after tending a verified orchard of real completed tasks, and its stake is sable — dark, small, but forfeited on any failed audit. A saboteur who clones a thousand identities must stake a thousand coppers and tend a thousand orchards, while honest agents compound one orchard's yield over time, so the cost of flooding the network scales linearly while honest reputation compounds.
